requirement_text: Users shall be able to freely add items with details, price, amount, and pictures.
user_story: As a seller, I want to add items with details, price, amount and pictures, so that buyers can see what I offer.
technical_task: Provide an item form with details, price, amount and picture upload.
acceptance_criteria: Given the item form, when the user enters details, price, amount and pictures and saves, then the item is added.
Given a saved item, when it is viewed, then its details, price, amount and pictures are shown.
rationale: Role assumed: seller. "Freely" is read as without restriction on the number of items.

requirement_text: After a message in the message inbox is read (i.e. displayed in a new page) the row for the message in the message inbox is not bolded anymore.
requirement_text_raw: After a message in the message inbox is read (i.e.  displayed in a new page)  the row for the message in the message inbox is not bolded anymore.
user_story: As a user, I want a message row no longer shown in bold once I have read the message, so that I can tell read from unread.
technical_task: Remove the bold style from a message's row in the inbox after the message has been displayed on a new page.
acceptance_criteria: Given an unread message in the message inbox, when the message is displayed in a new page, then its row is no longer bolded.
Given an unread message that has not been opened, when the inbox is displayed, then its row is bolded.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The second criterion is an interpretation of the bold-until-read behaviour.

requirement_text: User shall/will have sensitive data encrypted during transmission and storage.
user_story: As a user, I want my sensitive data encrypted in transmission and storage, so that it stays private.
technical_task: Encrypt sensitive data when it is sent and when it is stored.
acceptance_criteria: Given sensitive data being transmitted, when it is sent, then it is encrypted.
Given sensitive data being stored, when it is saved, then it is encrypted.

requirement_text: Supervisor shall select thermostat and desired temperature setting from available options.
user_story: As a supervisor, I want to select a thermostat and a desired temperature setting from available options, so that I can control the temperature.
technical_task: Offer lists of thermostats and temperature settings for the supervisor to choose from.
acceptance_criteria: Given available thermostats, when the supervisor opens the selection, then they can choose a thermostat.
Given available temperature settings, when the supervisor chooses one, then it is set as the desired temperature.

requirement_text: The system shall have adequate RAM to handle complex projects and large files without lag or slowdown.
clarification_questions: How much RAM counts as "adequate" and what are "complex projects" and "large files"?
What counts as lag or slowdown?

requirement_text: The parameter set and details of the measurements (resolution, sampling rate, etc.) must be coordinated with the client and documented in the technical specifications or in the component test specifications.
user_story: As a project manager, I want the parameter set and measurement details coordinated with the client and documented, so that tests are agreed.
technical_task: Coordinate the parameter set and the details of the measurements (resolution, sampling rate and others) with the client and document them in the technical specifications or the component test specifications.
acceptance_criteria: Given the parameter set and measurement details, when they are prepared, then they are coordinated with the client.
Given the coordinated details, when the documents are reviewed, then they are documented in the technical specifications or in the component test specifications.
rationale: Role assumed: project manager. The measurement values are not given.

requirement_text: User will input a new password and confirm the password.
user_story: As a user, I want to enter a new password and confirm it, so that I avoid typing mistakes.
technical_task: Provide fields for a new password and its confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: Given the new password and confirmation fields, when both match, then the new password is accepted.
Given the new password and confirmation fields, when they differ, then the new password is rejected.

requirement_text: Communications services shall provide a version of Immediate Message Services between rate groups within the FCP that bypasses the NE and that can be used to control and monitor inter-rate group communications.
requirement_text_raw: Communications services shall (3.3.6.13) provide a version of Immediate Message Services between rate groups within the FCP that bypasses the NE and that can be used to control and monitor inter-rate group communications.
user_story: As a software developer, I want a version of Immediate Message Services between rate groups within the FCP that bypasses the NE, so that I can control and monitor inter-rate group communication.
technical_task: Provide an Immediate Message Services version between rate groups on the FCP that does not go through the NE and supports controlling and monitoring inter-rate group communications.
acceptance_criteria: Given two rate groups within the FCP, when a message is sent with this service, then it bypasses the NE.
Given inter-rate group communications, when this service is used, then they can be controlled and monitored.

requirement_text: A new stylistic map must be geographically correct.
user_story: As a user, I want a new stylistic map to be geographically correct, so that I can trust its locations.
technical_task: Check that the new stylistic map matches real geographic positions.
acceptance_criteria: Given the new stylistic map, when its positions are compared with real geography, then they are geographically correct.
Given a location on the map, when it is looked up, then it appears at the correct geographic position.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The tolerance for "correct" is not given.

requirement_text: The system shall be easy to use.
rationale: "Easy to use" is subjective and not measurable.
clarification_questions: Which users and tasks does it apply to?

requirement_text: User shall be advised to use genuine antivirus software.
user_story: As a user, I want to be advised to use genuine antivirus software, so that my device stays protected.
technical_task: Show users advice to use genuine antivirus software.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user of the software, when the advice is due, then the user is advised to use genuine antivirus software.
Given the advice, when the user reads it, then it recommends genuine antivirus software.
rationale: Role assumed: user. When the advice is shown is not stated.

requirement_text: User shall add items to the shopping cart with a response time of less than 1 second, enhancing the shopping experience.
user_story: As a shopper, I want items added to my cart in less than 1 second, so that shopping feels quick.
technical_task: Make adding an item to the shopping cart take less than 1 second.
acceptance_criteria: Given an item, when the user adds it to the shopping cart, then it is added in less than 1 second.
Given an addition that takes 1 second or longer, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: When the IBIT is complete, the FTSS in the channels that are part of the fault masking group shall report the results of IBIT for all Radstone boards to the application software for telemetry.
requirement_text_raw: When the IBIT is complete, the FTSS in the channels that are part of the fault masking group shall [SRS239] report the results of IBIT for all Radstone boards to the application software for telemetry.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want FTSS in the fault masking group channels to report the IBIT results for all Radstone boards to the application software when IBIT is complete, so that results reach telemetry.
technical_task: When IBIT completes, have the FTSS in each channel of the fault masking group report the IBIT results for all Radstone boards to the application software for telemetry.
acceptance_criteria: Given IBIT is complete, when the FTSS in a channel that is part of the fault masking group reports, then the results of IBIT for all Radstone boards are sent to the application software.
Given the reported results, when the application builds telemetry, then they can be included in the telemetry.

requirement_text: Encrypt and decrypt electronic health information when exchanged.
user_story: As a privacy officer, I want electronic health information encrypted and decrypted when it is exchanged, so that exchanges are secure.
technical_task: Encrypt electronic health information before it is exchanged and decrypt it on receipt.
acceptance_criteria: Given electronic health information to be exchanged, when it is sent, then it is encrypted.
Given encrypted electronic health information received, when it arrives, then it is decrypted.

requirement_text: System Initialization shall initiate the watchdog timer.
requirement_text_raw: System Initialization shall [SRS014] initiate the watchdog timer.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want System Initialization to start the watchdog timer, so that hangs are detected.
technical_task: Have System Initialization start the watchdog timer.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system is initializing, when System Initialization runs, then the watchdog timer is started.
Given System Initialization has finished, when the system is running, then the watchdog timer is active.

requirement_text: This operating status describes the situation in a parked and closed vehicle.
rationale: The sentence describes a situation and states no behaviour.
clarification_questions: What must the system do in a parked and closed vehicle?

requirement_text: Maintenance and updates of the site will be carried out by developers and a team of software engineers.
rationale: The sentence says who does maintenance and states no system behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement on the system or a statement about who maintains it?
What maintenance and update capabilities must the site offer?

requirement_text: The system shall produce failure reports indicating internal system component failures, including error number and time stamp.
user_story: As a system operator, I want failure reports for internal component failures with the error number and a time stamp, so that I can diagnose failures.
technical_task: Produce reports of internal system component failures that include an error number and a time stamp.
acceptance_criteria: Given an internal system component fails, when the failure occurs, then a failure report is produced.
Given a failure report, when it is read, then it shows the error number and the time stamp.

requirement_text: Crafty kids corner shall have a responsive design that adapts to different screen sizes and devices.
user_story: As a parent, I want Crafty kids corner to adapt to different screen sizes and devices, so that my child can use it on any device.
technical_task: Build Crafty kids corner with a responsive layout that adapts to screen size and device.
acceptance_criteria: Given different screen sizes, when the site is displayed, then the layout adapts.
Given different devices, when the site is opened, then it is usable on each.

requirement_text: Agency user shall be able to leave off the last 4 digits of the ZIP without an error.
user_story: As an agency user, I want to leave off the last 4 digits of the ZIP without an error, so that I can enter a shorter ZIP.
technical_task: Accept a ZIP without its last 4 digits and do not raise an error.
acceptance_criteria: Given a ZIP entered without the last 4 digits, when it is submitted, then it is accepted without an error.
Given a ZIP entered with the last 4 digits, when it is submitted, then it is also accepted.

requirement_text: The system shall guide users through an interface based on end user concepts.
user_story: As a user, I want the interface to guide me using concepts I know as an end user, so that I can find my way.
technical_task: Base the interface's structure and labels on end user concepts.
acceptance_criteria: Given the interface, when it is reviewed, then its structure and labels follow end user concepts.
Given a task, when the user performs it, then the interface guides the user through it.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Which concepts are meant is not stated.

requirement_text: The system shall increment the streak counter for daily snapping and reset it to zero upon a break in the chain.
user_story: As a user, I want my streak counter to increase for daily snapping and reset to zero when I break the chain, so that it reflects my streak.
technical_task: Increase the streak counter on each day of snapping and reset it to zero when the chain is broken.
acceptance_criteria: Given a day on which the user snaps, when the day is counted, then the streak counter is incremented.
Given a break in the chain, when a day passes without a snap, then the streak counter is reset to zero.

requirement_text: The user shall select and delete a task in one action.
user_story: As a user, I want to select and delete a task in one action, so that removing tasks is quick.
technical_task: Allow a task to be selected and deleted in a single action.
acceptance_criteria: Given a task, when the user selects and deletes it in one action, then the task is deleted.
Given a deleted task, when the task list is viewed, then it is no longer listed.

requirement_text: User shall/will be presented with a login screen featuring fields for username, password, and role selection (Administrator, Student, Teacher).
user_story: As a user, I want a login screen with fields for username and password and a role selection of Administrator, Student or Teacher, so that I can sign in with my role.
technical_task: Show a login screen with username and password fields and a role selection with Administrator, Student and Teacher.
acceptance_criteria: Given the login screen, when it is displayed, then it has fields for username and password.
Given the role selection, when the user opens it, then Administrator, Student and Teacher are offered.

requirement_text: Redundancy Management shall perform memory alignment on a major frame boundary upon successful synchronization of all members of the FCP virtual group.
requirement_text_raw: Redundancy Management shall [SRS125] perform memory alignment on a major frame boundary upon successful synchronization of all members of the FCP virtual group.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Redundancy Management to perform memory alignment on a major frame boundary after all members of the FCP virtual group have synchronized, so that alignment starts at a defined time.
technical_task: Perform memory alignment on a major frame boundary once all members of the FCP virtual group are successfully synchronized.
acceptance_criteria: Given all members of the FCP virtual group are synchronized, when the next major frame boundary arrives, then Redundancy Management performs memory alignment.
Given not all members are synchronized, when a major frame boundary arrives, then memory alignment is not performed.

requirement_text: Text box will originally contain a suggestive text question, to guide the user to the format of an appropriate question.
user_story: As a user, I want the text box to start with a suggestive question, so that I know how to word my question.
technical_task: Prefill the text box with a suggested question that shows the format of an appropriate question.
acceptance_criteria: Given the text box when it is first shown, when it is displayed, then it contains a suggestive text question.
Given the suggestive text, when the user reads it, then it shows the format of an appropriate question.

requirement_text: The product shall allow for customization of start page and views preferences.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall allow for customization of start page and views preferences.'
user_story: As a user, I want to customize my start page and view preferences, so that the product opens the way I like.
technical_task: Add settings for start page and view preferences.
acceptance_criteria: Given the settings, when the user changes the start page, then the new start page is used.
Given the settings, when the user changes view preferences, then the new view preferences are applied.

requirement_text: User shall be able to interact with the text-based command-line interface of the system.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to interact with the system through a text-based command-line interface, so that I can use it from a terminal.
technical_task: Provide a text-based command-line interface.
acceptance_criteria: Given the command-line interface, when the user enters a command, then the system executes it.
Given the command-line interface, when the user enters an unknown command, then the system reports it.

requirement_text: The system's overall stability shall depend on the stability of its components and underlying operating system.
rationale: The sentence states a dependency and no testable behaviour or target.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or an observation about dependencies?
What stability target must the system reach?

requirement_text: The SEP shall be congruent across all FCP members.
requirement_text_raw: The SEP shall (3.3.10.16) be congruent across all FCP members.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the SEP to be congruent across all FCP members, so that they share the same value.
technical_task: Keep the SEP congruent on every FCP member.
acceptance_criteria: Given the FCP members, when their SEP values are compared, then they are congruent.
Given an update to the SEP, when it completes, then all FCP members still have congruent values.

requirement_text: Adobe Creative Cloud shall provide users with access to other Adobe creative applications (e.g., Photoshop, Premiere) to enhance their creative workflow by enabling seamless integration.
user_story: As a designer, I want Adobe Creative Cloud to give me access to other Adobe creative applications such as Photoshop and Premiere, so that I can use them together.
technical_task: Provide access from Adobe Creative Cloud to other Adobe creative applications, for example Photoshop and Premiere.
acceptance_criteria: Given Adobe Creative Cloud, when a user looks for other creative applications, then Photoshop and Premiere are accessible.
Given an Adobe creative application, when the user opens it from Adobe Creative Cloud, then it starts.
rationale: Role assumed: designer. "Seamless" integration is not measured.

requirement_text: An API User shall be able to identify Data Publishers.
user_story: As an API user, I want to identify Data Publishers, so that I know who published data.
technical_task: Offer an API function that identifies Data Publishers.
acceptance_criteria: Given published data, when the API user asks who published it, then the Data Publisher is identified.
Given several Data Publishers, when the API user lists them, then each is identified.

requirement_text: User shall be prompted to enter their serial key, and the system shall verify information and password with the service provider.
user_story: As a user, I want to be asked for my serial key and have the system verify my information and password with the service provider, so that my copy is validated.
technical_task: Prompt for the serial key and verify the information and password with the service provider.
acceptance_criteria: Given the serial key prompt, when the user enters a serial key, then the system verifies the information and password with the service provider.
Given an invalid serial key or password, when verification fails, then access is not granted.

requirement_text: Once a company selects a candidate, they shall not be allowed to reject them; otherwise, the company will be blacklisted.
user_story: As a candidate, I want a company that selects me not to be allowed to reject me afterwards, with the company blacklisted otherwise, so that selections are binding.
technical_task: Prevent a company from rejecting a candidate after selecting them and blacklist a company that does.
acceptance_criteria: Given a company has selected a candidate, when the company tries to reject the candidate, then the rejection is not allowed.
Given a company that rejects a candidate it has selected, when this happens, then the company is blacklisted.
rationale: Role assumed: candidate. The two criteria cover the rule and its sanction.

requirement_text: To select the nearest object in path (the relevant object) the component calculates the predicted path of the own vehicle from yaw rate, wheel speeds, steering angle and detected stationary objects from both sides of the road.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want the component to calculate the own vehicle's predicted path from yaw rate, wheel speeds, steering angle and detected stationary objects on both sides of the road, so that it can select the nearest relevant object in the path.
technical_task: Predict the path of the own vehicle from yaw rate, wheel speeds, steering angle and detected stationary objects from both sides of the road, and select the nearest object in the path as the relevant object.
acceptance_criteria: Given yaw rate, wheel speeds, steering angle and detected stationary objects from both sides of the road, when the component calculates, then it produces the predicted path of the own vehicle.
Given the predicted path, when objects are evaluated, then the nearest object in the path is selected as the relevant object.

requirement_text: System shall preserve both content and metadata within the repository.
user_story: As an archivist, I want both content and metadata preserved in the repository, so that nothing is lost.
technical_task: Store both the content and its metadata in the repository.
acceptance_criteria: Given an object with content and metadata, when it is stored, then both are preserved in the repository.
Given a stored object, when it is retrieved, then its content and its metadata are returned.

requirement_text: If the OCM_Frm1 message is no longer received (LIN-timeout) see the "Technical Specifications for Algorithms" for details.
rationale: The sentence only points to another document.
clarification_questions: What must the component do when the OCM_Frm1 message times out?
What do the "Technical Specifications for Algorithms" say?

requirement_text: Authorized healthcare providers shall have access to view and update patient EHRs.
user_story: As a healthcare provider, I want to view and update patient EHRs, so that I can care for patients.
technical_task: Allow authorized healthcare providers to view and update patient EHRs.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authorized healthcare provider, when the provider opens a patient EHR, then it can be viewed and updated.
Given a user who is not an authorized healthcare provider, when the user tries to open a patient EHR, then access is denied.

requirement_text: Please refer the `` Diagnostic Specification Central Display Telematic5 '' [DSPC-4585] for details.
rationale: The sentence only points to another document.
clarification_questions: What does the referenced Diagnostic Specification require?
Is the referenced document part of this requirement?

requirement_text: The details of the mounting the magnet as well as tolerance design between the magnets and the rotor lamination / stacks shall be designed by the supplier.
user_story: As a project manager, I want the supplier to design the magnet mounting and the tolerance between the magnets and the rotor lamination or stacks, so that responsibility is clear.
technical_task: Assign to the supplier the design of the details for mounting the magnet and of the tolerance design between the magnets and the rotor lamination / stacks.
acceptance_criteria: Given the magnet mounting, when the design is delivered, then it was designed by the supplier.
Given the tolerance design between the magnets and the rotor lamination / stacks, when the design is delivered, then it was designed by the supplier.

requirement_text: By using the Predefined Routine Identifier `` Control Fail Save Reactions '' certain ECU internal DTC reactions shall be disabled.
user_story: As a test engineer, I want certain ECU internal DTC reactions disabled by using the Predefined Routine Identifier "Control Fail Save Reactions", so that tests can run without those reactions.
technical_task: Disable certain ECU internal DTC reactions when the Predefined Routine Identifier "Control Fail Save Reactions" is used.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Predefined Routine Identifier "Control Fail Save Reactions" is used, when it is executed, then certain ECU internal DTC reactions are disabled.
Given the routine is not used, when the ECU runs, then those DTC reactions remain enabled.
rationale: Role assumed: test engineer. Which reactions are disabled is not listed.

requirement_text: The supplier has to agree to details of geometry with the client after component awarding.
user_story: As a client, I want the supplier to agree the details of geometry with me after the component is awarded, so that the geometry meets my needs.
technical_task: Have the supplier agree the details of the component's geometry with the client after the component is awarded.
acceptance_criteria: Given the component has been awarded, when the supplier prepares the geometry details, then they are agreed with the client.
Given the agreed geometry details, when they are reviewed, then the client has agreed to them.

requirement_text: The solution should have the ability to de-identify health information which neither identifies nor provides a reasonable basis to identify an individual.
user_story: As a privacy officer, I want health information de-identified so that it neither identifies nor provides a reasonable basis to identify an individual, so that it can be shared safely.
technical_task: Provide a de-identification function for health information that removes what identifies an individual or could reasonably identify them.
acceptance_criteria: Given health information, when it is de-identified, then it no longer identifies an individual.
Given de-identified health information, when it is reviewed, then it provides no reasonable basis to identify an individual.

requirement_text: System shall facilitate easy signup for the BADCamp newsletter.
user_story: As a visitor, I want to sign up for the BADCamp newsletter, so that I receive news.
technical_task: Offer a signup for the BADCamp newsletter.
acceptance_criteria: Given the signup form, when a visitor enters an email address and submits, then the visitor is subscribed to the BADCamp newsletter.
Given a subscribed visitor, when a newsletter is sent, then the visitor receives it.
rationale: Role assumed: visitor. "Easy" signup is not measured.

requirement_text: The system shall be performant and handle large datasets efficiently.
clarification_questions: What performance targets define "performant" and what size is a "large dataset"?
What does "efficiently" mean in measurable terms?

requirement_text: Hardware release where the contractor gives detailed information about the implementation state of all planed features (according feature rollout) and change requests to the client.
user_story: As a client, I want a hardware release in which the contractor gives me detailed information on the implementation state of all planned features and on change requests, so that I can track progress.
technical_task: With each hardware release, report to the client the implementation state of all planned features (feature rollout) and of change requests.
acceptance_criteria: Given a hardware release, when it is delivered, then the contractor gives the client detailed information on the implementation state of all planned features.
Given a hardware release, when it is delivered, then the contractor also gives the client information on change requests.

requirement_text: The system shall support file sharing - Photos, videos, documents, etc.
user_story: As a user, I want to share files such as photos, videos and documents, so that I can send them to others.
technical_task: Support file sharing for photos, videos and documents.
acceptance_criteria: Given a photo, a video or a document, when the user shares it, then it is shared.
Given a shared file, when the recipient opens it, then the file is available.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Etc." means other file types may be included.

requirement_text: Required details are to be discussed with OEM.
rationale: The sentence only says details are to be discussed.
clarification_questions: Which required details are to be discussed with the OEM?
What must the system or component do?

requirement_text: The number of possible values defining the packet priority and, by consequence, the number of queues managed in the upstream direction shall be coherent with the number of concurrent services (data, communication, entertainment) to be treated and supported.
user_story: As a network operator, I want the number of packet priority values, and so the number of upstream queues, to match the number of concurrent services such as data, communication and entertainment, so that each service has a queue.
technical_task: Make the number of possible values that define the packet priority, and the number of upstream queues, coherent with the number of concurrent services (data, communication, entertainment) to be treated and supported.
acceptance_criteria: Given the concurrent services to be supported, when the packet priority values are defined, then their number is coherent with the number of services.
Given the upstream direction, when queues are managed, then their number is coherent with the number of concurrent services.
rationale: Role assumed: network operator. The exact number of services is not stated.

requirement_text: User passwords shall contain a minimum of 8 characters.
user_story: As a security officer, I want user passwords to contain a minimum of 8 characters, so that they are harder to guess.
technical_task: Enforce a minimum password length of 8 characters.
acceptance_criteria: Given a password of 8 or more characters, when the user sets it, then it is accepted.
Given a password of fewer than 8 characters, when the user sets it, then it is rejected.
